pred_diagnosis: Drug-Induced Liver Injury (DILI) due to Alfuzosin

1: Serologic tests for HBsAg, anti-HBc IgM, anti-HCV, anti-HAV IgM, anti-HEV, HEV RNA, and HCV RNA were negative.
2: Autoimmune markers (ANA, AMA, ASMA, LKM-1) were negative.
3: Metabolic evaluations—including transferrin saturation, ferritin, alpha-1 antitrypsin, ceruloplasmin, 24-hour urinary copper, and ophthalmologic exam for Kayser–Fleischer rings—were normal.
4: Abdominal ultrasonography showed normal liver, gallbladder, common bile duct, and intrahepatic bile ducts.
Magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography demonstrated a normal biliary anatomy.
